about: The public keys of the URTC family, where each one is embedded and where its private half lives. Only public values and file names are written here; no secret ever is. tools/keys.py verify reads every embedding and fails when one differs from the value below.

keys.role: Signs every asset of an official release (the .sig files); the flasher, the web studio and the publishing tool check it before they trust a download.
keys.private_half: Outside every repository (the file named by URTC_RELEASE_KEY, by default ~/.urtc-keys/urtc_release_ed25519.pem). The release workflow holds no signing key: it only verifies.

keys.role: The PUBLIC development HMAC key for the main board, kept only for the bootloaders of the earlier generation: the current main bootloader holds no HMAC key at all and verifies an Ed25519 record against the public trust table (keys/image_trust.json).
keys.private_half: None: this one is published on purpose. The line master= of the secret file only feeds the HMAC that bootloaders of the earlier generation check; it is never written to a file of a repository. The expansion slave bootloader holds no key at all.

secrets_not_stored_here: The production HMAC key of the main board for bench bootloaders of the earlier generation (the line master= of the secret file).
The private half of the release signature key and the private half of the image signature key.

other_ecosystems.where: documented and verified by that ecosystem's own repositories; this registry lists only the URTC family
